output.content: I am flagging a hard constraint for the upcoming sprint. The current setup lacks any form of drift detection. I will not proceed with tuning the model parameters under these conditions. If the drift monitoring remains manual or absent, I refuse to adjust the weights or hyperparameters. I need the pipeline to automatically flag distribution shifts before I touch the code. Without that automated safety net, I am stepping back from the optimization work. I cannot guarantee performance if I cannot see when the input data has changed. This is a non-negotiable requirement for my continued involvement in the tuning phase.
